to.description: The last item to keep on the active branch.

settings.description: What to change. Anything absent stays as it is.

requested.description: The speed the session asked for.

served.description: The speed the request ran at, or will run at.

anyOf.description: The tier's own rate limit was reached.

description: Generated from the Rust types in crates/cortex-protocol by `cargo xtask schema`. Do not edit. The root accepts any JSON-RPC message; the typed contents of each method are in x-cortex-methods.
title: Cortex-Harness protocol

initialize.description: The handshake. It must be the first request on a connection.

mcp/status.description: The state of the MCP servers.

permissions/list.description: Lists the approvals in force for a session.

plan/update.description: Applies a user's edits to the plan.

project/list.description: Reads the project profile and memory.

project/update.description: Accepts, edits, disables, deletes or promotes entries.

session/close.description: Stops using a session on this connection. The session is kept.

session/compact.description: Compacts now, with optional focus instructions.

session/fork.description: Makes a new session from a point in this one.

session/new.description: Creates a session: workspace, models, level, overrides.

session/open.description: Opens a stored session. Returns its metadata and current state.

session/read.description: Reads items of a session from the log, in pages. Also how a client catches up after a gap in `seq` or an `item.resync`.

session/rewind.description: Moves the active branch back to an earlier item.

session/set.description: Changes a session's settings: models, reasoning level, speed, level.

turn/interrupt.description: Cancels the running turn. It is not an error when none is running. With `now`, running commands are killed at once.

turn/start.description: Sends a prompt. If a turn is running, `delivery` says whether to steer it or to queue behind it.

usage/get.description: Token, cost and cache figures for the session, live.

usage/report.description: Usage and cost for a range, grouped, with limits left.

verify/run.description: Runs the project's checks now. The outcome arrives as events.

session/event.description: One event of a session. The only notification the server sends.

approval/request.description: Asks whether a tool call may run. Unanswered: deny.

question/ask.description: Asks the user a question. Unanswered: the asker is told "no answer".

trust/request.description: Asks whether to trust a project's executable resources. Unanswered: not trusted.
